_comment: Hand-authored place-type templates for /simulate's routine/arc mechanism (design debrief 2026-08-10). An archetype is authored once here, not per character - texture and 'provides' are shared by every routine tagged with this archetype. A character's routine references one of these by name plus a one-line personal specialization (see character SKILL.md). Starter set below covers the place-types already implied by the existing cast (Terfila as a port/market town, Görff as workshop/archive territory, the Feria as a waystation of sorts) - expand by hand as new routines need a place-type that isn't here yet, same discipline as everything else authored rather than generated in this system.

market.texture: Buying and selling, price disputes, scarcity, trust in a trading partner or supplier, goods that come and go with the season or the ships.

workshop.texture: Making things by hand, materials ordered or scavenged, apprentices, pride or shame in the work's quality, tools that need tending as much as the product does.

archive.texture: Records, attribution, gaps in the record, the physical work of maintaining what's stored, contradictions between sources.

waystation.texture: Travelers passing through, news carried in and out, brief contact that isn't expected to repeat, schedules and delays.
